title: Dome hardware arrival assertion accepts missing or NaN azimuth
summary: Missing numeric data leaves current=NAN. The comparison distance > tolerance is false for NaN and dome_hw_at returns true. A temporary unchanged-header harness with empty cache and call dome_hw_at(0,90,0.1) exits 0 despite printing missing number item DOME_HORIZONTAL_COORDINATES.AZ. Actual callers include test_dome_baader_hw.c:127, test_dome_nexdome_hw.c:136 and test_dome_nexdome3_hw.c:142. Require successful item retrieval and finite inputs before accepting arrival. No hardware was operated.
